About Mark

Mark David Hadley spent his career as a director of respiratory therapy. Now he's putting his energy into art: documentary film, video, writing, and storytelling.

He was born with ectrodactyly, which gives him eight fingers. That's where the name 8 Finger Mankind comes from.
